tex_content.html: \begin{example} \end{example}[The square distance-to-boundary function] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0457 1. apph:H.34\group Generalized gradients On $C=[-1,1]^2$, the function $f(x,y)=-d((x,y),\partial C)=\max \{ |x|,|y|\} -1$ belongs to $\Xzero (C)$ and is nonsmooth on $\{ |x|=|y|\} $. \end{example}
